items.difficulty_reason: (2) => (1) immediate. For (1) => (2) refine the pulled-back cover to finitely many affines W_j (etale-affine lemma) and prove three algebraic statements: etale under-glueing and faithful-etale over-glueing both follow from the exact-sequence characterization 0 -> A -> A_f ⊕ A' -> A'_f -> 0 being preserved by (faithfully) flat base change A -> B; finite products are glueable because finite products are direct sums and direct sums preserve the exact sequences of the characterization ('we omit the proof of (2)', one-line corollary of the characterization stated in the same proof).
